outfits.name: Beach Day — First Meeting
outfits.prompt: Base (swimwear) — A sporty dark teal bikini top with a simple, secure triangle cut, paired with matching dark teal bikini bottoms cut mid-hip. Over it, an unbuttoned, oversized cream-white linen shirt left open and rolling at the sleeves, the hem long enough to graze her thighs. Simple black rubber sandals on her feet, and a thin braided leather bracelet on one wrist., Everyday (art-school grunge) — A faded charcoal-grey vintage graphic tee, oversized and slightly rumpled, worn loose over high-waisted baggy light-wash denim jeans cropped above the ankle with a raw frayed hem. A thin black leather belt threaded through the jeans. Chunky worn-in black combat boots unlaced at the top and scuffed at the toe. A small silver hoop earring in one ear, a thin black leather cord necklace, and an oversized faded olive-green flannel shirt tied lazily around her hips., Date night — A slinky black ribbed knit crop top with a subtle cowl neckline, fitted enough to read intentional, tucked loosely into high-waisted deep burgundy wide-leg trousers that pool slightly over chunky black platform boots. A cropped structured black blazer over the top, sleeves pushed up to the forearms. A delicate silver chain necklace with a tiny crescent-moon pendant, small silver hoop earrings, and a swipe of deep plum-tinted lip balm.
